fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32)
fields.name: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - Process
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path="C:\\Program Files\\Windows Media Player\\osk.exe" or (tgt.process.image.path="C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe" and src.process.cmdline="\"C:\\Windows\\system32\\mmc.exe\" \"C:\\Windows\\system32\\eventvwr.msc\" /s")) and (tgt.process.integrityLevel in ("High","System","S-1-16-16384","S-1-16-12288"))))
